Other delivered libraries: 27, @nextcloud/logger 3.0.3, webdav 5.11.0, axios 1.21.0, dompurify 3.4.17, focus-trap 8.2.4, core-js 3.37.0, and 21 more.
Packages and versions are those the .license files beside the chunks name, since the source maps miss packages through the toolchain defect named here.

Known toolchain defect: vite-plugin-css-injected-by-js 4.0.1 in package-lock.json, where the CSS is injected by JavaScript, puts the code that injects the CSS in front of the chunk without shifting its source map, so the map the bundler combines from it loses sources. Here the map of cache/l10n-lint/educai/js/BotForm-B8LcQM9E.chunk.mjs names 0 of the 1 package its .license file names, and 4 further chunks show the same.
The app runs as built; only the map is short, so the frameworks and libraries are read from the .license files instead.
Built in a copy with @nextcloud/vite-config 3.0.0-beta.1, vite 8.3.5, the copy does not build: npm install failed with "npm error code ERESOLVE".

40 delivered files carry no source map, 11 files do. The bytes of the unmapped ones are charged only where the code shows its origin by itself: a copy of a file of the checkout, the glue of the bundler, code of the bundler and its plugins.
2 packages are imported by their root in src, each delivered in fewer than 8 modules, so a per-module import has nothing to leave out and the specifier decides no bytes here.
